authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13139 gives Pali/Prakrit satta and Hindi/Marwari/Gujarati/Awadhi sāt. Assimilation of pt and simplification of the resulting geminate support the numeral. The same survey locality independently records hukəlu “dry”, ek hau “one hundred”, corroborating initial s/ś > h locally. These are source-local comparisons, not transferred locality evidence. Exact comparative records are preserved in local-h-matrix.json. Intra-IA transmission, if any, remains open.
